ex_zh: 其實我早就知道了。
ex_py: Qíshí wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le.
ex_en: Actually, I already knew a long time ago.

ex_zh: 我打算週末去爬山。
ex_py: Wǒ dǎsuàn zhōumò qù páshān.
ex_en: I plan to go hiking this weekend.

ex_zh: 我還在適應新的環境。
ex_py: Wǒ hái zài shìyìng xīn de huánjìng.
ex_en: I'm still adapting to the new environment.

ex_zh: 儘管很累，他還是準時到了。
ex_py: Jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā háishi zhǔnshí dào le.
ex_en: Even though he was tired, he still arrived on time.

ex_zh: 請提醒我明天要帶雨傘。
ex_py: Qǐng tíxǐng wǒ míngtiān yào dài yǔsǎn.
ex_en: Please remind me to bring an umbrella tomorrow.

ex_zh: 天氣逐漸變冷了。
ex_py: Tiānqì zhújiàn biàn lěng le.
ex_en: The weather is gradually getting colder.

ex_zh: 我們應該避免浪費時間。
ex_py: Wǒmen yīnggāi bìmiǎn làngfèi shíjiān.
ex_en: We should avoid wasting time.

ex_zh: 電燈突然熄滅了。
ex_py: Diàndēng tūrán xīmiè le.
ex_en: The light suddenly went out.

ex_zh: 不好意思，麻煩你幫我拿一下。
ex_py: Bù hǎoyìsi, máfan nǐ bāng wǒ ná yíxià.
ex_en: Sorry to trouble you, could you hold this for me for a moment?

ex_zh: 我想嘗試一種新的做法。
ex_py: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì yì zhǒng xīn de zuòfǎ.
ex_en: I want to try a new approach.

ex_zh: 這個方法的效果很好。
ex_py: Zhège fāngfǎ de xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.
ex_en: This method works very well.

ex_zh: 快一點，否則會趕不上車。
ex_py: Kuài yìdiǎn, fǒuzé huì gǎn bú shàng chē.
ex_en: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.

ex_zh: 他假裝沒有聽到我說的話。
ex_py: Tā jiǎzhuāng méiyǒu tīngdào wǒ shuō de huà.
ex_en: He pretended not to hear what I said.

ex_zh: 這部電影讓我很感動。
ex_py: Zhè bù diànyǐng ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
ex_en: This movie moved me a lot.

ex_zh: 這段路至少要走三個小時。
ex_py: Zhè duàn lù zhìshǎo yào zǒu sān ge xiǎoshí.
ex_en: This stretch takes at least three hours on foot.

ex_zh: 我很願意幫你。
ex_py: Wǒ hěn yuànyì bāng nǐ.
ex_en: I'm very willing to help you.

ex_zh: 剛開始學難免會犯錯。
ex_py: Gāng kāishǐ xué nánmiǎn huì fàn cuò.
ex_en: When you're just starting to learn, making mistakes is unavoidable.

ex_zh: 我週末要整理房間。
ex_py: Wǒ zhōumò yào zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
ex_en: I'm going to tidy my room this weekend.

ex_zh: 她很勇敢地說出了自己的想法。
ex_py: Tā hěn yǒnggǎn de shuō chū le zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
ex_en: She bravely spoke out her thoughts.

ex_zh: 我等了很久，結果他沒有來。
ex_py: Wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ, jiéguǒ tā méiyǒu lái.
ex_en: I waited a long time, and in the end he didn't come.

ex_zh: 我發現手機不見了。
ex_py: Wǒ fāxiàn shǒujī bú jiàn le.
ex_en: I realized my phone was missing.

ex_zh: 不用擔心，一切都會好的。
ex_py: Bú yòng dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de.
ex_en: Don't worry, everything will be fine.

ex_zh: 我對這個城市還不太熟悉。
ex_py: Wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hái bú tài shúxī.
ex_en: I'm not very familiar with this city yet.

en: while you're at it, on the way
ex_zh: 你出門的時候，順便幫我買杯咖啡。
ex_py: Nǐ chūmén de shíhou, shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi.
ex_en: When you go out, pick up a coffee for me while you're at it.

ex_zh: 最近下雨的天數增加了。
ex_py: Zuìjìn xiàyǔ de tiānshù zēngjiā le.
ex_en: The number of rainy days has increased recently.

ex_zh: 與其抱怨，不如想辦法解決。
ex_py: Yǔqí bàoyuàn, bùrú xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué.
ex_en: Rather than complain, it's better to find a way to solve it.

ex_zh: 週末我只想輕鬆地休息。
ex_py: Zhōumò wǒ zhǐ xiǎng qīngsōng de xiūxí.
ex_en: On weekends I just want to rest and take it easy.

ex_zh: 我會盡量準時到。
ex_py: Wǒ huì jǐnliàng zhǔnshí dào.
ex_en: I'll try to arrive on time as far as I can.

ex_zh: 這只是一個小誤會。
ex_py: Zhè zhǐshì yí ge xiǎo wùhuì.
ex_en: This is just a small misunderstanding.

ex_zh: 這件衣服太小了，我想退貨。
ex_py: Zhè jiàn yīfú tài xiǎo le, wǒ xiǎng tuìhuò.
ex_en: This piece of clothing is too small, I'd like to return it.

ex_zh: 難得有機會見面。
ex_py: Nándé yǒu jīhuì jiànmiàn.
ex_en: It's rare to have a chance to meet.

ex_zh: 謝謝你邀請我參加生日派對。
ex_py: Xièxie nǐ yāoqǐng wǒ cānjiā shēngrì pàiduì.
ex_en: Thank you for inviting me to the birthday party.

ex_zh: 我正在準備明天的考試。
ex_py: Wǒ zhèngzài zhǔnbèi míngtiān de kǎoshì.
ex_en: I'm preparing for tomorrow's exam.

ex_zh: 我想幫忙，結果反而讓事情更複雜。
ex_py: Wǒ xiǎng bāngmáng, jiéguǒ fǎn'ér ràng shìqing gèng fùzá.
ex_en: I wanted to help, but it ended up making things more complicated.

ex_zh: 你想吃什麼？隨便都可以。
ex_py: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Suíbiàn dōu kěyǐ.
ex_en: What do you want to eat? Anything is fine.

ex_zh: 天氣會影響我的心情。
ex_py: Tiānqì huì yǐngxiǎng wǒ de xīnqíng.
ex_en: The weather affects my mood.

ex_zh: 他堅持自己的看法，不肯讓步。
ex_py: Tā jiānchí zìjǐ de kànfǎ, bù kěn ràngbù.
ex_en: He insisted on his own view and wouldn't give way.

ex_zh: 這件事由我負責。
ex_py: Zhè jiàn shì yóu wǒ fùzé.
ex_en: I'm responsible for this matter.

ex_zh: 想到明天的旅行，我就很興奮。
ex_py: Xiǎngdào míngtiān de lǚxíng, wǒ jiù hěn xīngfèn.
ex_en: Thinking about tomorrow's trip makes me really excited.

ex_zh: 老師很重視學生的意見。
ex_py: Lǎoshī hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de yìjiàn.
ex_en: The teacher values the students' opinions.

ex_zh: 請稍微等一下。
ex_py: Qǐng shāowēi děng yíxià.
ex_en: Please wait a moment.

ex_zh: 我一點也不後悔這個決定。
ex_py: Wǒ yìdiǎn yě bù hòuhuǐ zhège juédìng.
ex_en: I don't regret this decision at all.

ex_zh: 這家餐廳很值得一試。
ex_py: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn zhídé yí shì.
ex_en: This restaurant is well worth a try.

ex_zh: 我勉強趕上了最後一班車。
ex_py: Wǒ miǎnqiǎng gǎn shàng le zuìhòu yì bān chē.
ex_en: I only just caught the last train.

ex_zh: 每個地方的習俗都不一樣。
ex_py: Měi ge dìfāng de xísú dōu bù yíyàng.
ex_en: Every place has different customs.

ex_zh: 首先要準時，其次要有禮貌。
ex_py: Shǒuxiān yào zhǔnshí, qícì yào yǒu lǐmào.
ex_en: First be on time, second be polite.

ex_zh: 我們應該尊重不同的意見。
ex_py: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng bùtóng de yìjiàn.
ex_en: We should respect different opinions.

ex_zh: 週末我喜歡去書店逛逛。
ex_py: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān qù shūdiàn guàngguang.
ex_en: On weekends I like to browse around bookstores.

ex_zh: 我們沿著河邊散步。
ex_py: Wǒmen yánzhe hébiān sànbù.
ex_en: We took a walk along the riverside.

ex_zh: 山上的景色真美。
ex_py: Shān shàng de jǐngsè zhēn měi.
ex_en: The scenery on the mountain is really beautiful.

ex_zh: 我們明天早上八點出發。
ex_py: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn chūfā.
ex_en: We set off at eight tomorrow morning.

ex_zh: 我剛好有空，可以陪你去。
ex_py: Wǒ gānghǎo yǒu kòng, kěyǐ péi nǐ qù.
ex_en: I happen to be free, so I can go with you.

ex_zh: 我們約在車站見面吧。
ex_py: Wǒmen yuē zài chēzhàn jiànmiàn ba.
ex_en: Let's arrange to meet at the station.

ex_zh: 臨時有事，我不能去了。
ex_py: Línshí yǒu shì, wǒ bù néng qù le.
ex_en: Something came up at the last minute, so I can't go.

ex_zh: 這兩個字的意思差不多。
ex_py: Zhè liǎng ge zì de yìsi chàbuduō.
ex_en: These two characters have about the same meaning.

ex_zh: 你知道它們的區別嗎？
ex_py: Nǐ zhīdào tāmen de qūbié ma?
ex_en: Do you know the difference between them?

ex_zh: 可以請你再解釋一次嗎？
ex_py: Kěyǐ qǐng nǐ zài jiěshì yí cì ma?
ex_en: Could you explain it once more?

ex_zh: 沒想到這麼快就下雨了。
ex_py: Méi xiǎngdào zhème kuài jiù xiàyǔ le.
ex_en: I didn't expect it to rain so soon.

ex_zh: 幸好我帶了傘。
ex_py: Xìnghǎo wǒ dài le sǎn.
ex_en: Luckily I brought an umbrella.

ex_zh: 我們先找個地方躲雨吧。
ex_py: Wǒmen xiān zhǎo ge dìfāng duǒ yǔ ba.
ex_en: Let's find somewhere to shelter from the rain first.

ex_zh: 你有什麼理由不去？
ex_py: Nǐ yǒu shénme lǐyóu bú qù?
ex_en: What reason do you have for not going?

ex_zh: 他承認自己做錯了。
ex_py: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ zuò cuò le.
ex_en: He admitted that he had done wrong.

ex_zh: 請原諒我來晚了。
ex_py: Qǐng yuánliàng wǒ lái wǎn le.
ex_en: Please forgive me for being late.

ex_zh: 這是一次很特別的經驗。
ex_py: Zhè shì yí cì hěn tèbié de jīngyàn.
ex_en: This was a very special experience.

ex_zh: 我不想錯過這個機會。
ex_py: Wǒ bù xiǎng cuòguò zhège jīhuì.
ex_en: I don't want to miss this opportunity.

ex_zh: 我們要珍惜和朋友相處的時間。
ex_py: Wǒmen yào zhēnxí hé péngyǒu xiāngchǔ de shíjiān.
ex_en: We should cherish the time we spend with friends.

ex_zh: 我偶爾會自己做飯。
ex_py: Wǒ ǒu'ěr huì zìjǐ zuòfàn.
ex_en: I occasionally cook for myself.

ex_zh: 週末我通常睡到很晚。
ex_py: Zhōumò wǒ tōngcháng shuì dào hěn wǎn.
ex_en: On weekends I usually sleep in late.

ex_zh: 難怪他這麼累，他昨天沒睡。
ex_py: Nánguài tā zhème lèi, tā zuótiān méi shuì.
ex_en: No wonder he's so tired; he didn't sleep yesterday.

ex_zh: 太遠了，乾脆搭計程車吧。
ex_py: Tài yuǎn le, gāncuì dā jìchéngchē ba.
ex_en: It's too far, let's just take a taxi.

ex_zh: 一切都很順利。
ex_py: Yíqiè dōu hěn shùnlì.
ex_en: Everything went smoothly.

ex_zh: 恭喜你通過考試！
ex_py: Gōngxǐ nǐ tōngguò kǎoshì!
ex_en: Congratulations on passing the exam!

ex_zh: 他的態度很友善。
ex_py: Tā de tàidù hěn yǒushàn.
ex_en: His attitude is very friendly.

ex_zh: 我喜歡誠實的人。
ex_py: Wǒ xǐhuān chéngshí de rén.
ex_en: I like honest people.

ex_zh: 每個人都有自己的缺點。
ex_py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de quēdiǎn.
ex_en: Everyone has their own shortcomings.

ex_zh: 過年的時候，街上特別熱鬧。
ex_py: Guònián de shíhou, jiē shàng tèbié rènao.
ex_en: At New Year, the streets are especially lively.

ex_zh: 這是一個很古老的傳統。
ex_py: Zhè shì yí ge hěn gǔlǎo de chuántǒng.
ex_en: This is a very old tradition.

ex_zh: 這間餐廳的氣氛很舒服。
ex_py: Zhè jiān cāntīng de qìfēn hěn shūfu.
ex_en: This restaurant has a comfortable atmosphere.

ex_zh: 我在圖書館比較容易專心。
ex_py: Wǒ zài túshūguǎn bǐjiào róngyì zhuānxīn.
ex_en: I find it easier to concentrate in the library.

ex_zh: 手機常常讓我分心。
ex_py: Shǒujī chángcháng ràng wǒ fēnxīn.
ex_en: My phone often distracts me.

ex_zh: 休息一下，效率反而會更高。
ex_py: Xiūxí yíxià, xiàolǜ fǎn'ér huì gèng gāo.
ex_en: Taking a short break actually makes you more efficient.

ex_zh: 請保持安靜。
ex_py: Qǐng bǎochí ānjìng.
ex_en: Please keep quiet.

ex_zh: 到了以後請跟我聯絡。
ex_py: Dào le yǐhòu qǐng gēn wǒ liánluò.
ex_en: Please contact me once you arrive.

ex_zh: 我們還沒有決定要去哪裡。
ex_py: Wǒmen hái méiyǒu juédìng yào qù nǎlǐ.
ex_en: We haven't decided where to go yet.

en: kill two birds with one stone (idiom)
ex_zh: 邊走路邊聽課，真是一舉兩得。
ex_py: Biān zǒulù biān tīng kè, zhēnshi yì jǔ liǎng dé.
ex_en: Listening to a lesson while walking is really killing two birds with one stone.

ex_zh: 我的中文馬馬虎虎。
ex_py: Wǒ de Zhōngwén mǎmǎhūhū.
ex_en: My Chinese is so-so.

ex_zh: 有些事不用勉強，順其自然就好。
ex_py: Yǒuxiē shì búyòng miǎnqiǎng, shùn qí zìrán jiù hǎo.
ex_en: Some things needn't be forced; just let them take their course.

en: when in Rome, do as the Romans do (idiom)
ex_zh: 到了新的地方，要入境隨俗。
ex_py: Dào le xīn de dìfāng, yào rù jìng suí sú.
ex_en: When you arrive in a new place, do as the locals do.

en: half the effort, double the result (idiom)
ex_zh: 用對方法就能事半功倍。
ex_py: Yòng duì fāngfǎ jiù néng shì bàn gōng bèi.
ex_en: With the right method you get twice the result for half the effort.

ex_zh: 語言是熟能生巧的。
ex_py: Yǔyán shì shú néng shēng qiǎo de.
ex_en: With language, practice makes perfect.
